items.problem: An AppX-schema-invalid capability sequence prevented launch but the validator returned PASS.
items.evidence: migration-score.json reports runs=false; session-log.txt lines 3508-3557 show 0xC00CE014/0x80080204 downgraded to WARN.
items.root_cause: Capability order was undocumented and no-registration was always treated as environmental. Tier 1 is required because prose alone can be ignored; the deterministic validator and launch classification can enforce the rule.
items.change: Check that runFullTrust precedes custom/device capabilities, return invalid-manifest for explicit registrar schema errors, fail validation for that status, and document the order.
items.expected_effect: Schema-invalid manifests cannot produce a successful migration result, while genuine environment-only registration failures remain warnings.
items.falsifiable_check: On rerun, the original wrong-order manifest emits a validator FAIL before completion; after moving runFullTrust first, registration no longer returns 0xC00CE014/0x80080204.

items.problem: Bootstrap copied legacy AssemblyInfo.cs into an SDK-style target and caused CS0579 duplicate attributes.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3322-3369 show six duplicate assembly attribute errors from BackgroundTask\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs.
items.root_cause: The mechanical copy treated generated legacy assembly metadata as application source. A Tier 1 exclusion is stronger than adding another build-error paragraph and prevents the defect rather than teaching recovery.
items.change: Exclude every legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs from bootstrap copy and mapping generation.
items.expected_effect: Classic UWP projects and folded child projects use SDK-generated assembly metadata without CS0579 conflicts.
items.falsifiable_check: Bootstrapping this source no longer copies or maps BackgroundTask\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, and the first build has no duplicate assembly attribute errors.

items.problem: The skill prescribed winapp build, but the installed CLI has no build command.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2599-2665 show the command exiting 1 as unrecognized.
items.root_cause: The instructions assigned compilation to the package-identity CLI. This is inherently a Tier 3 command correction; no new tool or scaffold is needed because dotnet build already exists and the validator already uses it.
items.change: Replace migration-agent winapp build commands with explicit native dotnet build commands and clarify that winapp is used for run.
items.expected_effect: The build loop starts with a supported command and avoids a wasted recovery turn.
items.falsifiable_check: A rerun contains no attempted winapp build invocation and reaches the first real compiler diagnostic through dotnet build.
